Devices running unsupported Windows versions must upgrade to a supported release to maintain Windows Update access. events.one_liner: Midnight Mimosa is a malware campaign discovered and analyzed by Bitdefender that comes pre-installed in the firmware of low-cost Android devices built on MediaTek platforms. events.title: GoBalance vulnerability allows Tor .onion address hijacking via key recovery
events.one_liner: GoBalance, a Tor load-balancing tool written in Go and distributed with EndGame (a toolkit for keeping dark-web sites online during denial-of-service attacks), contains a vulnerability that allows attackers to recover the private keys controlling .onion addresses using only publicly available information. The flaw was disclosed by Searchlight Cyber on October 8, 2026. The vulnerability exists in GoBalance's key-signing implementation: Tor private keys are 64 bytes long, but GoBalance passed only the first 32 bytes to the signer and discarded the remaining 32 bytes—the portion that keeps each signature's secret value hidden. Without this discarded half, the secret value becomes a fixed number that anyone can compute from a single published descriptor, allowing recovery of the site's long-term master key without server access. Because the recovered key is the site's master key rather than a short-lived one, it can be used to sign valid records for the address indefinitely into the future. The vulnerability affects only GoBalance sites whose master keys are stored in Tor's native key format; sites using GoBalance's setup tool, which writes keys in a safer format, are not at risk. The original Onionbalance and Tor itself are unaffected. The flaw was publicly revealed through the takeover of Dread, one of the dark web's largest forums, between October 5 and 7, 2026: both of Dread's .onion addresses were compromised and redirected to a rival site called Conclave. Dread's operators initially attributed the first takeover to an accidental private key upload but later acknowledged the second address takeover as evidence of the GoBalance vulnerability being exploited. Dread moved to a new address and instructed users to change passwords; the operators confirmed Dread's servers were not breached. HugBunter stated that several dark-web markets also had their addresses taken over via the vulnerability, though specific names were not disclosed.

events.title: Canopy bridges in Amazon reduce roadkill and enable safe animal crossings
events.one_liner: Eight canopy bridges were installed in Alta Floresta, Mato Grosso state, Brazil starting in 2024, connecting fragmented forest patches across a highway. takeaways: Vulnerabilities discovered December 2025; attacker with chat access to one agent can extract credentials from IMDS metadata

Weak Firecracker MicroVM isolation, IMDSv1 (lacking IMDSv2 mitigations), overly broad agent permissions
Attacker can access ECR, pull agent container images, run as root, extract source code, inspect memory resources
Attacker can access user conversations and agent sessions
